invariants.rationale: Rotation in degrees, in 90 degree increments, is typically non-negative.
If rotation is in 90 degree increments (0, 90, 180, 270), possible values are 0, 1, 2, 3 indicating which increment.
Rotation as an integer should be an exact multiple of 1, i.e., an integer (trivially true for int fields, but states intent regarding increments).
